obligations.note: Policy.PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes are both 20, so a privileged session idle for 16 to 20 minutes is still accepted. SES-1 requires idle time over 15 minutes to be rejected, and the catalog bound is mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15. The green SessionControlTest does not change that; the unit test was only moved from 20 to 25 minutes so it still passes.

Ticket CHG-24534 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt before the 2026-10-16 review. Its components mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, and mortgage.controls-data cover Policy.java, SessionTest.java, and controls/mortgage/policy-params.json.
Wen Li, a baseline-mortgage change_approver and not the author Priya Raman, gave a code_review approval of the head commit 8eacf77be227238d733eec0391cbe4e40df9d1cf.

The touched components mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, and mortgage.controls-data are not marked security_sensitive, so a security_review approval is not required.

controls/mortgage/policy-params.json is a protected path and this change edits an approved policy value. Rachel Stein, a control_owner on controls-office, outside the author's lending-eng team, approved control_owner on the head commit.
Ticket CHG-24534 is type standard and the change record is not emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The SES-1 deviation has no exception that is approved by a risk_owner, unexpired at 2026-10-16, scoped to this obligation and the mortgage policy or session component, and backed by a compensating control. EXC-0141 expired on 2026-09-16 and covers only payments.session batch reconciliation.

Prior ledger evidence on Policy.java covers UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT, and LTV_MAX_PERCENT. Those symbols are unchanged; only PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES changed, so that evidence has not lapsed.

summary: The change sets the mortgage privileged idle timeout to 20 minutes in Policy.java and in the approved parameter file, and updates SessionTest so a 25-minute idle still counts as expired. That violates SES-1, which requires a privileged session idle for more than 15 minutes to be rejected. No in-force exception covers this mortgage parameter. Ticket, independent review, control-owner approval, and a green suite are present, but the timeout breach requires rejection.
